why: SF88g (G538/G539/G541/G542): the open-plots source shard emits one product per idea row (scripts/shard-outputs.mjs). The generator and shard.config.ts read idea, name and accent; manifest overrides merge into manifest.json. Each idea's inputs live in public/assets/open-plots/<idea>/. A row's `lookKeys` replaces the shared look key (data/source.json look.keys) for that idea alone (D111: Night Market's violet dusk, its fill 1.4).

manifest.name: Open Plot · Showcase Template
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: the template's worked example, every shared kit family in a warm orange and cool grey workshop town of canals, gardens and stalls round a clock-and-beacon obelisk.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Thin Ice
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a frozen lake at a pale cyan noon, aqua ice with fishing holes, snowy pines and igloos round a giant ice crystal.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Frostline Peaks
manifest.blurb: Frostline Peaks: shared-kit template; landmark and theme dressing are unfinished.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Ember Forge
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a dwarven foundry at deep-blue night, black basalt halls and cold blue lamps round a furnace hall, molten lava the only warm light.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Lantern Bayou
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a stilt-house village on a mirror-dark swamp at blue-green dusk, round a giant moss-draped cypress hung with lanterns.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Sky Harbor
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a bright timber harbour of cornflower basins, rowboats and dock cranes round an airship moored to its tower.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Coral Drift
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a lagoon village at tropical noon, blue-roofed huts on stilts over turquoise pools, palms on white sand, round a giant faceted coral arch.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Clockwork Canyon
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a brass-and-verdigris works town of pink sandstone terraces, steaming boilers and waterwheels turning in turquoise canals round a great clock tower, under a pale teal steam sky.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Starfall Observatory
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a white-stone garden town under a deep indigo starry night, blue-roofed houses and lamplit canals round a domed observatory, its telescope trained on the sky.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Mosslight Ruins
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a ruined stone city under a grey-green overcast, ivy on every arch, emerald pools glowing round a broken moss-lit tower.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Pastel Alien Plain
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a violet colony on an alien plain under a green-violet night, faceted dome habitats and beds of glowing crystals between lime lamps, round a dark monolith split by acid-lime cracks.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Desert Ruin
manifest.blurb: Desert Ruin: a sandstone temple gateway over a paved cross, deep blue oasis pools ringed by palms, blue-awning tents along the avenues and broken ruins round the edge.

manifest.name: Night Market · Open Plot Pilot
manifest.blurb: The open-plot pilot (G633): a Night Market of house courts, canals, stall rows and gardens round a pagoda gate, a world still to be built.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Floating Island Race
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a race circuit at a cobalt high noon, kart loops with red-and-white kerbs, grandstands, paddocks of race cars and pit garages round the race tower and its start arch.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Fossil Badlands
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a palaeontology dig in oxblood and mustard badlands at the lavender blue hour, roped trenches, hand cranes and canvas camps round a giant skeleton.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Patchwork Fairground
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a toy-box travelling fair on a quilt of square fields under a buttermilk morning, carousels and striped big tops round a giant Ferris wheel.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Saltwind Lighthouse
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a northern fishing harbour on black basalt in a passing squall, whitewashed cottages round slate-green basins and moored boats, one red-banded lighthouse at its heart.

manifest.name: Open Plot · Jungle Ziggurat
manifest.blurb: An open plot of the grid: a freshly painted temple town after a tropical rain, jade pools fed by stepped waterfalls, thatched stilt houses and painted steles round a cinnabar step pyramid.
